transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I suppose I’m here because I’ve been feeling a little stuck. Not in a dramatic way, I don’t think, but more like… quietly convinced that the best part of my life may be behind me. And I keep thinking that even if I’m disciplined or make plans, I’m not sure it would really get me back to feeling like myself. I’m not sure if that makes sense.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things anymore—like activities or hobbies you used to enjoy?

I’m not sure I’d say I don’t take pleasure in things at all. I mean… I still can enjoy things here and there, if that’s what you mean. Maybe I’m just not as enthusiastic as I used to be, but I wouldn’t want to overstate it. Does that answer it?
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, even when you’re not actively thinking about the future or your current situation?

Yes… I think so. I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around crying or anything like that, but most days there’s this sort of low, gray feeling underneath things. Even if I’m in the studio, or just having dinner with my wife, it’s still there in the background. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or lacking in energy most days, even if you haven’t done anything particularly strenuous?

Yes… I suppose I have noticed that. I mean, I still get up and do the shopping, and I tinker with little projects, so I don’t want to make it sound like I’m unable to function. But small things seem to wear me out more than they should—setting up for a mentoring session, or just walking around at a community event. Afterward I feel really drained, and a nap doesn’t quite put me back together. Is that the sort of tiredness you mean?
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, focus, or make decisions lately?

I don’t think so… not in any major way. I mean, I’m 65, so I suppose I misplace a word now and then or take a little longer deciding what to do, but I haven’t really noticed a clear change in my thinking or focus. My wife hasn’t said anything either. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking about?
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty about things you’ve done, or maybe feeling like you’re not worth as much as you used to?

I don’t think so… not especially. I mean, I have the usual regrets, I suppose, things I might’ve done differently, but I wouldn’t say I’m walking around feeling guilty all the time. And I don’t think I feel worthless, exactly. Maybe just… not quite as useful as I used to be, but that seems fairly normal at my age, doesn’t it?
How long have you been feeling this way most days? Has it been going on for weeks, months, or longer?

It’s been… longer than weeks, definitely. I’d say it started after my hiking injury, a little over three years ago. So maybe around three years and three months now. I know that sounds like a long time, but it hasn’t been dramatic every day—just sort of there most days, if that makes sense.
